name: dimethyl fumarate capsules 240mg
description:
Dimethyl fumarate capsules 240mg for sale

Buy Dimethyl Fumarate 240 mg Capsules are a prescription medicine used to treat relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis (MS). They contain the active ingredient dimethyl fumarate, which helps reduce relapses, slow disease progression, and decrease new brain lesions associated with MS. Generic dimethyl fumarate is equivalent to the brand-name medicine

What Dimethyl Fumarate 240 mg Is Used For

• Relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis (RRMS)

• Clinically isolated syndrome (CIS)

• Active secondary progressive multiple sclerosis (SPMS

The Treatment is usually started at 120 mg twice daily for 7 days, then increased to the maintenance dose of 240 mg twice daily. Capsules should be swallowed whole and not crushed, chewed, or opened.
